items.text:
A true revival changes the way people live.
It changes how husbands treat their wives.
It changes how wives treat their husbands.
It changes how parents raise their children.
It changes how young people make decisions.
It changes how people conduct business.
It changes how we treat the poor.
It changes how we respond to those who disagree with us.
It changes our attitudes toward sin.
warnings: joined unlabeled detail line(s) under this point

items.text: It changes our commitment to prayer and Scripture
warnings: short line with no ending punctuation made a bullet point; it may be a heading instead

items.reason: verse text quoted above its reference; text is fetched from the Bible provider
items.text: “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such there is no law.”

items.quoted: “But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control. Against such there is no law.”

items.text:
A genuine response to a spiritual awakening should make us more like Jesus.
It should make us more loving, more compassionate, more truthful, more forgiving, and more committed to righteousness.
The evidence of a genuine revival is not merely how loudly people shout in church, but how faithfully they live for Jesus when they leave church!
warnings: joined unlabeled detail line(s) under this point

items.label: KEY #5)
items.text:
THERE MUST BE CONVERGENCE
Convergence is the act or state of coming together from different directions to meet at a common point, limit, or similarity.
warnings: joined unlabeled detail line(s) under this point

items.quoted: “There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called in one hope of your calling; one Lord, one faith, one baptism; one God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.”

items.text: The devil wants to divide the church over secondary matters while the world waits to hear the primary message of salvation!
A SPIRITUAL AWAKENING CAN UNITE PEOPLE WHO HAVE BEEN DIVIDED

items.label: KEY #6)
items.text:
BELIEVE IN THE POWER OF THE GOSPEL
A revival that begins in the heart can eventually influence a family, a community, a church, and even a nation.
warnings: joined unlabeled detail line(s) under this point

items.text: CONCLUSION: WHAT AMERICA AND THE WORLD NEEDS MOST IS ANOTHER SPIRITUAL AWAKENING

We should pray and follow these keys for another spiritual awakening.
We need revival in our pulpits.
We need revival in our pews.
We need revival in our homes.
We need revival among our young people.
We need revival in our communities.
And we need revival in our own hearts.
The greatest contribution Christians can make to America is not simply to argue about what is wrong with the nation, but to live and proclaim the gospel that can change the hearts of its people.
warnings: joined unlabeled detail line(s) under this point
